cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put a strip of tape on the box, like you did. That's the packing you asked for, finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's a label. Tape the lid shut so the books stay in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. One strip across the lid. That's your lid shut, exactly as requested.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bottom's open too. Seal that so I can load it in the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Top and bottom sealed, then. I'll leave it here for you; you asked for packing, not carrying.

reason: Make each narrow instruction actually fulfilled: label versus lid, then bottom, then packing versus carrying.
